name: Merak
description: The Maserati Merak (1972–1983) shared the Bora's distinctive body shell but used a smaller 3.0-litre V6 engine from the Citroën SM. A more accessible mid-engine Maserati, the Merak SS variant later received 220 hp and proper sport credentials.
